name: cbm
description: Query the codebase-memory code graph from a shell: callers, dependencies, impact, dead code, and ADRs.

interface.shortDescription: Shell queries over the codebase-memory code graph.
interface.longDescription: Runs codebase-memory-mcp cli against an indexed repository with no MCP server involved, so a shell script or an agent without the MCP tools can still ask structural questions: who calls a function, how a change propagates, which modules cluster together, which functions have no callers, and what a symbol's source says.
defaultPrompt: What breaks if I change this symbol?
